title: Correct the command-deck note's path to the fixture snapshot script
task:

Required: change the path in both language files to `apps/command-deck/scripts/snapshot-fixtures.ts` (and `apps/command-deck/public/fixtures/` for the output directory the same sentence names), keep every other word of the paragraph, and re-record the pair with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-19-command-deck.md`.

Constraints: facts only; do not edit the deck's README or script; no other notes; no new Agent Note.
